the falcon zta integration enables beyondcorp enterprise to use real time device information from crowdstrike falcon zero trust assessment for access and device management decisions
the beyondcorp enterprise client connector enables identity aware access for non web applications through secure connections from endpoint devices to cloud and non cloud apps
the microsoft intune integration enables beyondcorp enterprise to collect real time device information from intune for device management and access control
chrome security insights is available to protect against insider risk and data loss through enhanced monitoring of chrome activity across an organization
the tanium integration allows beyondcorp enterprise to collect real time device data from tanium for policy based device management and access control
iap tcp forwarding enables secure tunnel access to endpoints using private ips or hostnames including resources connected through interconnect or vpn
cross organization authorization allows beyondcorp enterprise policies to trust and use attributes from other organizations for access control
the chrome enterprise premium file transfer connector enables scanning of files transferred between different file systems on chromeos
rule based custom warning messages let administrators define custom text shown to users when a chrome dlp rule blocks an action
chrome enterprise premium watermarking displays custom watermarks on web pages that match configured data protection rules
chrome ocr adds optical character recognition scanning for sensitive content in image files and images embedded in pdfs
iap saml attribute propagation enables saml attributes to be passed through identity aware proxy authentication flows
the generative ai url category can be used in chrome dlp rules to classify websites that generate ai created content
chrome security insights enables enhanced monitoring of chrome activity to help detect insider risk and data loss
identity aware proxy reauthentication adds support for requiring users to reauthenticate during an active session
the beyondcorp enterprise policy remediator provides users with guided steps to remediate access denied issues
iap allowed domains allows administrators to specify permitted domains for identity aware proxy usage
